steps.label: LIGHTGBM
steps.sub: leaf-wise trees, fast on big data

eyebrow: LightGBM · plan is a category dtype
code:
lg = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=8, subsample=0.8,
    subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8)
lg.fit(X_fit, y_fit,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    eval_metric="auc",
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(30)])
caption: Stopped at round 115 on our illustrative churn data.

eyebrow: CatBoost · plan is a string column
code:
cb = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=500, learning_rate=0.05,
    depth=4, eval_metric="AUC",
    early_stopping_rounds=30, verbose=0)
cb.fit(X_fit_cb, y_fit,
    cat_features=["plan"],
    eval_set=(X_val_cb, y_val))
caption: Stopped at round 123. Same splits as before.

eyebrow: Test AUC, one split, then five splits
